Cassette now checks for a YouTube Music session as soon as sign-in reaches YouTube Music, even if the page continues loading. Unfinished verification attempts time out with recovery instructions, and a failed or canceled attempt preserves the previous session.

If Google asks you to confirm sign-in on your phone, approve the prompt or choose another verification method in the Google window.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/ctrlcat0x/Cassette/compare/v1.7.5...v1.8.0)
